property_summary: The reference C never writes l1FeeScalar under any caller, so after any setL1BlockValues call the getter c.l1FeeScalar() stays 0; the mutant stores the passed scalar whenever the require passes, which is reachable by pranking address(0) (depositorAccount is uninitialized), so a fuzzed _l1FeeScalar != 0 breaks the rule.
change_summary: Insert an assignment storing the passed _l1FeeScalar into the state variable l1FeeScalar after the require check, so the value becomes observable via the public l1FeeScalar() getter.
